verdict.rationale: DBOS has no documented in-product AI insights feature; neither Conductor nor the console is described as generating suggestions. The only related evidence is the official MCP server, which lets your own external LLM or agent analyze and manage DBOS workflow data. That gives AI-driven analysis only through an extra tool, not inside the product. Missing for 10: native in-product AI-generated insights or suggestions in Conductor or the console, documentation of what insights are produced, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
